segments.verbatim_es: Tiene que salir del avion, tiene que bajar
segments.translation_en: You have to leave the plane, you have to get off.
segments.transcription_notes: reanchored from STG-5.seg-1 (method=text, confidence=high, text_ratio=1.0); offset would pick seg-2 (drift 1.87s)

segments.verbatim_es: Ya activamos seguridad. Igual va a tener que bajar
segments.translation_en: We already activated security. You are still going to have to get off.

segments.verbatim_es: Yo salgo solo. Pero pruebame eso, por que es simplesmente alguien que no le gusto de la pregunta que lo hice y esta intentando hacer eso. Simplesmente, entiendes?
segments.translation_en: I'll leave on my own. But prove that to me, because it's simply someone who didn't like the question I asked and is trying to do that. Simply, you understand?

segments.verbatim_es: Yo estoy tranquilísimo porque estoy muy enojado porque perdí mi vuelo, fui humillado.
segments.translation_en: I'm extremely calm because I'm very angry because I lost my flight, I was humiliated.

segments.verbatim_es: En ese caso deve saber como son los procedimentos
segments.translation_en: In that case you must know how the procedures are.
